tools.name: zebra_start_session
tools.description:
Start a new car insurance quote. Call this once, before any other quote tool, and pass the returned
quote_handle to every later tool call for this quote.

tools.name: zebra_get_rc1_rates
tools.description:
Get estimated auto insurance rates (RC1 quotes) for the user, from the carriers they can buy from online on
The Zebra.

Call zebra_start_session first and pass its quote_handle. Usually takes about 30 seconds: wait for the result
rather than calling again or starting a new session. On UPSTREAM_UNAVA

tools.name: zebra_get_rate_action
tools.description:
Get the next step for the quote the user chose. Pass the quote_handle from zebra_start_session and the chosen
quote's quote_id from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

Follow recommended_next if present; otherwise give the user the url to continue buying the policy on The Zebra.

tools.name: zebra_get_rc2_questions
tools.description:
Get the questions the carrier needs answered before the user can buy the quote they picked.

Ask the questions in order. Ask a question if any of its visibility_conditions is met, or, when it has none,
if is_visible is true. Check this again after each answer, because an answer can make new question

tools.name: zebra_submit_rc2_answers
tools.description:
Submit the user's answers to the questions from zebra_get_rc2_questions, all at once. This sends them to the
carrier, so confirm them with the user first.

On success, a licensed insurance agent at agency_phone finishes buying the policy with the user. Present

tools.name: zebra_get_rc2_price
tools.description:
Get the carrier's final price for a quote after zebra_submit_rc2_answers.

The carrier usually returns the final price 3 to 5 minutes after the answers are submitted. Each call waits a while
for it.
While price_status is in_progress, keep calling this tool without waiting for the user.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "zebra_get_rc1_rates" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get estimated auto insurance rates (RC1 quotes) for the user, from the carriers they can buy from online on The Zebra. Call zebra_start_session first and pass i…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zebra_get_rate_action, zebra_get_rc2_questions, zebra_submit_rc2_answers, zebra_get_rc2_price · Public sink: zebra_get_rc2_questions, zebra_submit_rc2_answers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zebra_get_rate_action, zebra_get_rc2_questions, zebra_submit_rc2_answers, zebra_get_rc2_price · Public sink: zebra_get_rc2_questions, zebra_submit_rc2_answers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "zebra_get_rc1_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
